description: This file defines a Flutter widget named LoginScreen, which provides a user interface for email/password login, handles validation, manages submission state, interacts with the AuthProvider for authentication, and displays relevant UI states such as loading and error messages.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that renders a login form and manages user interaction for authentication.

classes.name: _LoginScreenState
classes.description: State class for LoginScreen, manages form controllers, validation, UI states, and submission logic.

methods.name: _validateEmail
methods.description: Validates the email input ensuring it is non-empty and contains '@' and '.' characters.

methods.name: _validatePassword
methods.description: Validates the password ensuring it is non-empty and at least 4 characters long.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Handles form submission: validates inputs, invokes the login method from AuthProvider, manages UI loading states, and sets error messages.
